literal: According to one's means, properly knowing, give; that is the way of preserving and distributing wealth.
translation: Give to others according to your means, knowing the proper way; that is the path to preserve and distribute your wealth.
modern: ஒருவர் தன் வருவாயின் அளவுக்கு ஏற்ப, அறநெறியை அறிந்து பிறருக்குக் கொடுக்க வேண்டும்; அதுவே செல்வத்தைப் பாதுகாத்து வழங்கும் வழியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the importance of giving within one's capacity. The word 'āṟṟiṉ' means according to one's ability or financial means, emphasizing that charity should not exceed what one can afford. 'Aṟa aṟintu' means knowing the proper, virtuous way of giving. The poet explains that giving in this balanced, mindful manner is actually the true path to both preserving and distributing one's wealth without destroying oneself.
